importantNotes: Some Thessalonians had quit working, believing Christ had already returned — Paul corrects this.
'If anyone is not willing to work, let him not eat' (3:10) — addressing idleness.
The 'man of lawlessness' (2:3) is a key eschatological figure — debated throughout church history.
The letter teaches that Christ's return should motivate faithfulness, not laziness.
Paul signs the letter in his own hand (3:17) to prove its authenticity.

chapters.1: Thanksgiving for their growing faith amid persecution; God's righteous judgment is coming.
chapters.2: The Day of the Lord has not come yet; the man of lawlessness will be revealed first.
chapters.3: Pray for the gospel to spread; warning against idleness — work quietly and earn your bread.
